$comment: Migration-only: the module of every top-level declaration in the single-file packages/octane/src/runtime.ts, read by scripts/split-runtime.mjs split, order and check --suggest. Once the split lands, the concept modules are the source of truth.
modules: listed in evaluation order, the permitted order `node scripts/split-runtime.mjs order` found gzip compresses best; `units` names declarations, `after:<name>` the statement after <name>.

unpinned: dependencies the facade does not import for order. The dev server's profile fold removes every import of them once it folds the profiling guards, and production bundles keep none of their code, so an order link would only load them in vite dev.
sectionComments: declarations whose detached leading comment, a section header, moves to the named module.
facade:
This module is the runtime's facade. The runtime lives in ./runtime/, one module per concept, and those modules are the source to edit. The exports below are the runtime's surface. `node scripts/split-runtime.mjs check` enforces the rules below on the split layout; the tool's map and its other commands were for the one-time split.

The links before them pin evaluation order. First come this runtime's dependencies, in the order the single-file runtime imported them, then the last module of the chain. Each runtime module first names the module that evaluates before it, back to the first. A link that imports nothing is an empty re-export: esbuild warns about a bare import of a side-effect-free module, a named import would be unused, and an ESTree printer rewrites `import {} from` as a bare import. verbatimModuleSyntax keeps these links through every transpile. Rolldown emits modules in evaluation order, so the chain keeps every optional driver and module-scope constant above the reads oxc folds or inlines. A module-scope initializer reads only its own module, so no bundler's order can reach a binding before its declaration.

modules.name: profile-probes
modules.title: Profiling probes
modules.summary: The profiling build's component override and attribution, and the DevTools scope inspectors. Only profile-guarded code imports this module, and the dev server's profile fold removes those imports, so it never loads while profiling is off. It is not in the evaluation chain.

modules.name: types
modules.title: Shared runtime types
modules.summary: Interfaces that several concept modules name: Block, Scope, the slot records, root render transactions and offscreen captures. Types compile away, so this module never loads. A type that one module alone names stays with that module.

modules.name: drivers
modules.title: Optional-capability drivers
modules.summary: The module-scope slots that core code tests by truthiness to reach an optional capability, and every function that assigns one. A bundle that never installs a capability never writes its slot, and oxc then drops the code the slot guards, but only in reads below the slot's declaration. This module evaluates before every module that reads them, so every read is below its slot. ESM lets only the declaring module assign a binding, so each installer lives here too.

modules.name: signal-owners
modules.title: Signal owners and native reads
modules.summary: Signal instance keys, renderer signal owners and their retry tracking, native style and projection bindings, and the native-read scopes and adoptions that compiled signal reads use.

modules.name: refs
modules.title: Refs and fragment refs
modules.summary: Ref attach and detach queues, ref callbacks and their cleanups, and FragmentInstance.

modules.name: engine
modules.title: Scheduler, root transactions and the commit pipeline
modules.summary: The update queue and flush, root render transactions and their journal, the commit and effect pipeline, transition scheduling, the ViewTransition commit and root creation. These functions assign each other's module-scope bindings, which only the declaring module may do, so they share this module. It evaluates after the drivers it reads.

modules.name: effects
modules.title: Effect queues
modules.summary: Effect queues and phases, deferred layout capture, the useSyncExternalStore commit sync, post-paint scheduling and commit order.

modules.name: view-transition
modules.title: View Transitions
modules.summary: ViewTransition boundaries, names, measurement, and the helpers of the native update callback. The engine runs the commit itself (vtFlush).

modules.name: hooks
modules.title: Hooks
modules.summary: Hook slots keyed by call site, and the state, reducer, linked state, effect, layout snapshot, memo, compiler memo, ref, imperative handle, store and id hooks.

modules.name: use
modules.title: use() and fetch warming
modules.summary: use(thenable) and the Suspense exception, batched parallel use(), fetch-tree warming, and the closure-free parallel-use ABI that the inline hook-memo tier compiles to.

modules.name: transitions
modules.title: Transitions
modules.summary: Transition action batches, holds and retries, pending signals, the transition memo harvest, startTransition and useDeferredValue.

modules.name: context
modules.title: Context
modules.summary: createContext and providers, use(Context) and useContext, scoped and native resolvers, dependency recording, hosted-root context requests, and cross-renderer region owners.

modules.name: hydration
modules.title: Hydration cursor
modules.summary: Adopting server DOM: the HydrationCapability cursor, server value differences and their diagnostics, the navigation helpers, and mismatch recovery.

modules.name: portals
modules.title: Portals
modules.summary: createPortal, portal slots and targets, and portal event ranges.

modules.name: block
modules.title: Blocks and Scopes
modules.summary: BlockImpl, ScopeImpl and LiteBlockImpl, Block creation, render-phase updates, a Block's returned output, and unmounting with teardown error routing. The render module renders a Block's body (renderBlockInner).

modules.name: hydrate-boundary
modules.title: Deferred hydration boundaries
modules.summary: `<Hydrate when={...}>`: strategies, prefetch, interaction replay, streamed boundaries and activation.

modules.name: suspense
modules.title: Suspense, @try and error boundaries
modules.summary: Try and error slots, catching render and effect errors, suspending, hiding and revealing content, retries, resuming, and initial Suspense hydration.

modules.name: render
modules.title: The render pass
modules.summary: renderBlockInner, lite component slots and every function that sets the render pass's state: the current Block and Scope, effect render versions, warm episodes, resume replay and the work-in-progress capture. That includes the Suspense and @try reveals, Hydrate activation, effect registration and event slots that render in place.

modules.name: roots
modules.title: Root API
modules.summary: Root options and error handlers, root containers and hydration fallbacks. The engine creates roots.

modules.name: hydration-presentation
modules.title: Early binding presentations
modules.summary: Hydrating compiled binding views: presentation frames and leases, and the writers that adopt an early presentation or refuse it.

modules.name: signal-bindings
modules.title: Signal bindings
modules.summary: Direct signal bindings for text, attributes, values and checked state, signal-backed host prop sources, and signal children.

modules.name: host-props
modules.title: Host props
modules.summary: The low-level host writers: text, attributes and their coercion, namespaces, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, styles, class names, spread props and host prop sources.

modules.name: elements
modules.title: Element descriptors
modules.summary: createElement, scoped elements and values, isValidElement, cloneElement, Children, and the Fragment and Activity sentinels.

modules.name: diagnostics
modules.title: Development diagnostics and profiling
modules.summary: The profiling counters this runtime declares, component source locations, and HTML nesting validation. The profiling probes themselves live in profile-probes.ts.

modules.name: component-slots
modules.title: Component slots
modules.summary: Component invocation as a Block, full and lite, memo bail-outs and context refresh, frontier rendering, children bodies, lazy, memo and HMR.

modules.name: child-slots
modules.title: Child slots and text holes
modules.summary: Renderable holes: childSlot and its value regimes, text holes, mapSlot and the compiler's cached arrays.

modules.name: branches
modules.title: Branches
modules.summary: `@if` and `@switch` branch slots, markerless arms and lite arms.

modules.name: deopt
modules.title: Descriptor renderer
modules.summary: The runtime de-opt renderer for markup produced at runtime: descriptor reconciliation, keyed descriptor children and host component descriptors.

modules.name: activity
modules.title: Activity
modules.summary: `<Activity mode>`: hiding and showing subtrees, with their refs and effects.

modules.name: lists
modules.title: Keyed lists
modules.summary: `@for` and keyed lists with LIS reconciliation, fast host lists and keyed selection.

modules.name: head
modules.title: Document head and resources
modules.summary: Hoisted `<title>`, `<meta>` and `<link>`, component-scoped `<style>` injection, resource hints, and Float stylesheet and script resources.

modules.name: commit
modules.title: Commit functions and the binding journal
modules.summary: Binding bags and their commit functions, slot `next` structures and frontiers, root ops lists, focus preservation across moves, and the journal that undoes a dropped render's binding writes.

modules.name: templates
modules.title: Templates
modules.summary: DOM operation bootstrap, template parsing and cloning, binding bag factories, and the text helpers compiled templates call.

modules.name: actions
modules.title: Form actions
modules.summary: React 19 actions: form action submission, useActionState, useFormStatus, useOptimistic and form resets.

modules.name: events
modules.title: Events
modules.summary: Native delegated events: handler slots and bundles, event-name parsing, delegation targets, portal-aware dispatch paths and propagation.

modules.name: forms
modules.title: Controlled forms
modules.summary: Controlled `value`, `checked` and `selected`, their restoration after native events, defaults, autofocus and form diagnostics.
